articles.title: WEATHER ADVISORY: Pagtaas ng Heat Index sa Bayan ng Lopez, Inaasahang Aabot sa 33–41°C
articles.deck: Nagbabala ang Lopez, Quezon MDRRMC hinggil sa pagtaas ng heat index na nasa 27–32°C simula alas-8 ng umaga at inaasahang aabot sa 33–41°C mula alas-11 ng umaga hanggang alas-2 ng hapon.
articles.body:
Nagbabala ang Lopez, Quezon MDRRMC hinggil sa pagtaas ng heat index sa bayan ng Lopez, na nasa 27–32°C simula alas-8 ng umaga at inaasahang aabot sa 33–41°C mula alas-11 ng umaga hanggang alas-2 ng hapon.

Ayon din sa Department of Science and Technology–Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (DOST-PAGASA), posibleng maranasan ang kategoryang Caution hanggang Extreme Caution batay sa Heat Index Category Guide hanggang Oktubre 12, 2026. Kabilang sa mga posibleng epekto ng matinding init ang pananakit ng ulo, pagkapagod, dehydration, at brain fog.

Pinapaalalahanan ang lahat na uminom ng sapat na tubig, magsuot ng angkop na damit, at gumamit ng proteksiyon tuwing lalabas upang maiwasan ang mga epekto ng matinding init ng panahon.

articles.title: KAGANAPAN NGAYON: Teachers’ Day Celebration 2026, Ipinagdiwang sa CEA Hall Room
articles.deck: Nakiisa ang mga guro ng PUP Lopez, Central Student Councils, at mga Academic Heads sa selebrasyon na may temang 'Behind Every Iskolar: Honoring the People Who Teach, Guide and Serve'.
articles.body:
Ipinagdidiriwang ngayong umaga ang Teachers’ Day Celebration 2026 sa CEA Hall Room na dinadaluhan ng mga guro ng PUP Lopez, Central Student Councils, at mga Academic Heads galing sa iba’t-ibang programa.

Itinetema ang selebrasyon ng “Behind Every Iskolar: Honoring the People Who Teach, Guide and Serve,” kung saan naglalayon ng pagbibigay-pugay at pasasalamat sa sipag at dedikasyon ng mga guro sa pagtuturo.

articles.title: KAGANAPAN NGAYON: Training-Workshop sa Updates ng IMs Development, PUP STAR, at LMS
articles.deck: Kasalukuyang isinasagawa via MS Teams ang training-workshop sa updates ng IMs Development, PUP STAR, at Learning Management System kasama ang CAL, ITech, PUP Ragay, at PUP Leyte.
articles.body:
Kasalukuyang dinadaluhan ng mga mag-aaral mula una hanggang ikaapat na taon ang “Updates on IMs Development, PUP STAR, and the Use of the Learning Management System” training-workshop na isinasagawa sa loob ng dalawang oras via MS Teams.

Gaganapin ang nasabing training-workshop sa loob ng dalawang araw, Oktubre 8–9, 2026, mula alas-8 ng umaga hanggang alas-5 ng hapon, katuwang ang mga kalahok mula sa College of Arts and Letters (CAL), Institute of Technology (ITech), PUP Ragay Campus, at PUP Leyte Campus.

articles.title: ANG HIMAYA PUBLICATION: Opisyal na Pamahayagang Mag-aaral ng PUP Lopez Kampus
articles.deck: “Pluma ng Katotohanan, Haligi ng Katapatan” — Alamin ang kasaysayan mula sa Epitome, ang kahulugan ng pangalan, bisyon, misyon, at pagtindig ng Ang Himaya.
articles.body:
ANG HIMAYA PUBLICATION
Official Student Kampus Publication of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines – Lopez Kampus

“Pluma ng Katotohanan, Haligi ng Katapatan”

ABOUT ANG HIMAYA
Ang Himaya Publication is the official student campus publication of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines – Lopez Kampus.

Guided by the principles of truth, integrity, editorial independence, and responsible journalism, Ang Himaya serves as a platform for informing and engaging the University community through news, features, opinions, literary works, multimedia content, and other forms of campus journalism.

The Publication seeks not only to document the events and experiences of the PUP Lopez community but also to cultivate student journalists who are competent, principled, critical, and socially responsible.

OUR NAME
The name “Ang Himaya” is derived from the Filipino word “himaya,” which signifies glory, honor, excellence, and distinction.

The name reflects the Publication's aspiration to uphold truth, integrity, and excellence in campus journalism while bringing honor to the Polytechnic University of the Philippines – Lopez Kampus through responsible, ethical, and independent journalism.

VISION
Ang Himaya Publication envisions itself as a credible, progressive, and competitive campus publication recognized for excellence in responsible journalism, impactful storytelling, and the fearless pursuit of truth. It aspires to transcend the boundaries of the University by producing principled and competent student journalists who contribute meaningfully to public discourse, uphold democratic values, and serve society through ethical and independent journalism.

MISSION
Ang Himaya Publication is committed to producing accurate, fair, ethical, and responsible journalism that informs, educates, and empowers the PUP Lopez Kampus community and the public. It shall provide a credible platform for the free exchange of ideas, promote critical inquiry and meaningful discourse, uphold truth, accountability, and editorial independence, and cultivate competent, principled, and socially responsible student journalists. The Publication shall actively participate in press conferences, journalism competitions, research initiatives, media collaborations, community engagement, and other professional and academic platforms to strengthen the competence of its members and promote the excellence of PUP Lopez Kampus.

OUR TAGLINE
“PLUMA NG KATOTOHANAN, HALIGI NG KATAPATAN”

The official tagline of Ang Himaya Publication embodies its commitment to truth, integrity, ethical journalism, and responsible service to the University community.

The pluma represents the journalist's responsibility to write, document, and speak truthfully.

The haligi represents the Publication's role as a steadfast institution that upholds katapatan—honesty, integrity, and faithfulness to its journalistic principles.

Together, the tagline reflects Ang Himaya's commitment to being a publication that does not merely tell stories, but carries the responsibility that comes with telling them.

OUR HISTORY
The story of Ang Himaya Publication begins with the changing landscape of campus journalism at PUP Lopez Kampus.

Before Ang Himaya, the University community was served by Epitome, a student publication that existed for approximately 22 years ago. During its later years, Epitome became increasingly associated with student activism and critical campus discourse. Its eventual discontinuation created a significant gap in the campus press, resulting in a long period without a formally established student publication.

This period marked a transition in the history of campus journalism at PUP Lopez. The absence of a publication meant that it would take several years before a new student press would emerge to once again provide a platform for campus news, student perspectives, and critical discourse.

In Academic Year 2024–2025, Ang Himaya Publication was established as a new chapter in the University's campus journalism tradition.

Starting with only 10 members, Ang Himaya began its work as the official student campus publication of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines – Lopez Kampus. While it inherited the broader tradition of campus journalism, Ang Himaya established its own identity, principles, and organizational foundation.

In the succeeding academic years, the Publication continued to grow. Its membership expanded, its coverage developed, and its participation in journalism and University activities increased.

By Academic Year 2026–2027, Ang Himaya had grown to approximately 40 members—a significant expansion from its original 10-member team.

Today, Ang Himaya continues to build its own institutional history while recognizing the place of Epitome in the earlier tradition of campus journalism at PUP Lopez.

The Publication carries forward the fundamental role of the campus press: to inform, to question, to document, and to serve the University community through responsible and independent journalism.

From the legacy of the past to the voices of a new generation, Ang Himaya continues to write the next chapter of campus journalism at PUP Lopez.

articles.title: PAGGUNITA | Gu-‘RAW’: Tagahulma ng ‘Masa’, Tagahubog ng Bukas
articles.deck: Kung paanong sa kamay ng magpapalayok, maging ang payak na putik ay nagkakaroon ng anyo at halaga—ganoon din tayo hinuhubog at patuloy na hinuhulma ng ating mga guro.
articles.body:
Kung paanong sa kamay ng magpapalayok, maging ang payak na putik ay nagkakaroon ng anyo at halaga, sa pamamagitan naman ng panadero, batid natin ang lasa ng pandesal na may mahusay na timpla—ganoon din tayo hinuhubog at patuloy na hinuhulma ng ating mga guro. Ang kanilang misyon na magpunla ng dunong ay hindi nagtatapos sa ating kakayahang gamitin at punan ng mga ideya ang isang malinis na kwaderno. Sa halip, tinatagos nito ang landas sa pagitan ng pagmulat at paglinang ng kinabukasan.

Bago malikha ang isang de-kalidad na palayok o anumang uri ng seramiko, nangangailangan ito ng maingat na pagmasa, paghawak nang may tiyaga, at pag-alalay sa pagdating ng puntong dapat na itong idarang sa apoy. Ito’y katulad ng bawat batang pumapasok sa paaralan; wala pang hubog, ngunit may sarili’t natatanging potensyal. Sa malumanay at produktibong paggabay ng guro, nahahanap ng mga ito ang tamang hulma ng kanilang bukas.

Kaya’t nakatalaga ang ika-5 ng Oktubre bilang “Pandaigdigang Araw ng mga Guro” upang bigyang-pugay ang mga taong haligi at saksi sa ating matayog na paglipad; mga gurong unang naniwala sa ating potensyal noong tayo’y wala pang hugis na tulad ng putik o luwad.

Guro. Titser. Maestro. Ikalawang Magulang. Instruktor. Tagahubog.

Sa iba’t ibang katawagan natin sila maaaring matukoy. Ngunit hindi maaaring iwaksi sa diwa ng kanilang ginagawa at sakripisyo ang salitang ‘kabayanihan’ at maging kabilang sa hanay ng itinuturing natin na mga bayani.

articles.title: Freshman Starter Pack: Sabado vs. Linggong May Formation
articles.deck: Minsan ka na nga lang nagising at natutulog nang maaga, bakit may formation pa?
articles.body:
Minsan ka na nga lang nagising at natutulog nang maaga, bakit may formation pa?

Isang pagsilip sa realidad ng buhay-kolehiyo ng isang freshman sa PUP Lopez: sa Sabado mahimbing ang tulog sa kama, ngunit pagsapit ng Linggo ng umaga, sasalubungin ka agad ng nakakapagod na formation sa ilalim ng sumisikat na araw.
